approved: Agriculture Legislation Amendment (Modernising Administrative Processes) Bill 2024
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would update administrative processes in agricultural legislation.
It would change the Primary Industries Research and Development Act 1989 and abolish the Rural Adjustment Act 1992.
The National Rural Advisory Council would be closed because its functions are now done elsewhere.
The bill would change appointment and governance rules under the Primary Industries Research and Development Act 1989.
The bill would repeal the Rural Adjustment Act 1992.
The bill would end the National Rural Advisory Council.
The bill would update the Natural Heritage Trust of Australia Act 1997 and add transitional rules.
People and organisations involved in agricultural research, development, and adjustment, including the National Rural Advisory Council.
Agriculture Legislation Amendment (Modernising Administrative Processes) Act 2024
